resources.string: Define an HTTP URL to retrieve in game values.\nAn HTTP server is necessary.\nAn internet access is required.
This URL does not start with \'http\'.
Variable brightness that will change depending on the data that are being shown on the screens.\nDisabling this can increase the risk of burn-in.\nThis parameter can be changed for each screen.

Enable interactivity with all screens. This parameter can be changed on each supported interactive screens.\nInteractive screens: Main screen, ETCS screen, SIAC screen\nNon-interactive screens: Info-LED screen
Changes the appearance of the TVM speed reduction announcement.\nActive: White diamond announcement on a gray background.\nInactive: White square announcement.
Enable a sound that will play in each changes of the TVM data that is being shown on the screen.\nSound frequency: 900 Hz
Welcome in the TGV 2N2 application. This application will allow you to retrieve in game data and shows them with different screens that actually use the TGV 2N2 in game.
This device is not very adapted for this app and will reduce immersive behavior.
